quest.title: Fishing For Jade
quest.description: In the aftermath of the collision between the Jade Chamber and That Which Lies in the Deep, the sea remains dotted with floating fragments of the Jade Chamber. The Millelith soldier Kun is currently looking for help with the cleanup work...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x50000, Adventurer's Experience x5

talks.objective: Clear the flotsam from the north wharf

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: A perfectly good Jade Chamber... Gone, just like that...

talks.objective: Clear the flotsam from the south wharf

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: Have you finished the cleanup?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I found these things...

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: Hmm... I suppose you can just keep that Mora. It isn't much, so I suppose you can keep it as compensation for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: This box, on the other hand, is unknown to me. You might want to pass it on to Baiwen.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: She's currently attending to some business at Yuehai Pavilion. Perhaps she might know what it is.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Hello, how may I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I picked this up from the sea...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Hmm? Allow me to have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Yes, this does indeed come from the Jade Chamber.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything specific you could tell me?

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Well, the contents consist of several documents and an announcement that has yet to undergo review. To think that they are still so well-preserved... How unexpected.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Still, your find should save us some work. Cleaning up after this mess really has proved an unending font of busywork.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Still, thank you for bringing these to us. Do take this as a token of our appreciation.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: They are somewhat out of date, but still, thank you for bringing these to us. Do take this as a token of our appreciation.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: Ah, the Jade Chamber... To think that it could truly be rebuilt...
